label: Monthly rent tax credit: annual rent ceiling
unit: KRW of annual rent eligible for the credit
appliesTo: Employees claiming the monthly rent tax credit
why: Recorded apart from the rate because the two move independently and because the cap is what makes the credit shrink in relative terms as rent rises. Above roughly ₩833,000 a month the credit stops growing, so for an expensive lease it becomes a fixed amount rather than a percentage — which changes how it behaves in a multi-year model.

history.source: National Tax Service — monthly rent tax credit for employees
history.note: Rent above the ceiling attracts no further credit. At the 17% rate the maximum credit is therefore ₩1,700,000 a year and at 15% it is ₩1,500,000 — worth entering as a capped amount in any cost model rather than as a percentage of whatever rent is actually paid.
